svg.title: Auto-UV from user request to saved profiles
svg.desc: Top-to-bottom scan lifecycle, tier reuse, bounded search, verification and all exit destinations.

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: User starts one tier or all three

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
01 · Prepare the GPU
Validate workloads and editable V/F points
Cache interrupted probes; reset stock offsets

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Resume selected
crash checkpoint?

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
02 · Establish the first baseline
Apply power, memory and tail policy
Measure stock; test the loaded flattened curve

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Restore checkpoint + power policy
Continue at clock selection, step 05

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Save the exact baseline checkpoint

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Abort this run

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
03 · Prepare the current tier
Efficiency → Balanced → Performance
Reuse baseline only when applied policies match

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Performance with matching
Balanced descent evidence?

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
05 · Apply the tier or custom clock policy
Bounded reclaim, OC or lower-clock steps
No second Efficiency voltage sweep

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
04 · Descend through lower voltage bins
Finite sweep; keep a passing selection
See the voltage-loop detail below

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
06 · Select a passing complete curve
Efficiency: highest measured FPS/W
Optional candidate and duration choice

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
07 · Verify the selected curve intact
Recheck blacklist and monotonic shape
Write a snapshot; run Q2RTX + CUDA

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
08 · Archive the verified profile
Tested points + tier + power + memory + metrics

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: More requested tiers?

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Next tier → step 03

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
At least one
profile completed?

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Finish with saved profiles and skipped-tier status

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
No new profile
Report last error or all tiers discarded

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Which run path?

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Skip this tier
Keep earlier completed profiles

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Higher-voltage saved
candidate available and chosen?

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Verify the higher saved voltage → step 07
